records.story_title: Powering 1,500 households through new energy partnerships
records.the_problem: Energy poverty across Sub-Saharan Africa limits economic growth, healthcare access, and community development.
records.what_they_built: BetaSunlight provides solar energy solutions as a sustainable alternative to slow grid expansion.
records.the_asip_connection: During the programme, SBC AfriTech helped facilitate partnerships with UBA Senegal, ANER, GOGLA, USADF, the All On-Shell Foundation, GIZ, and the Global Alliance for People and Planet.
records.where_they_are_now: The Cohort 4 report records $5K in monthly recurring revenue and 1,500 households served.

records.story_title: Opening Francophone markets through logistics partnerships
records.the_problem: Businesses expanding across Africa need dependable end-to-end logistics and supply-chain operations.
records.what_they_built: Messenger finances and aggregates logistics operations that connect businesses with their customers.
records.the_asip_connection: SBC AfriTech helped Messenger expand into Francophone Africa through partnerships with Yassir and PAPS Logistics in Senegal.
records.where_they_are_now: The Cohort 4 report records $25K in monthly recurring revenue, 20K deliveries, and 150 bikes financed.

records.story_title: Building a regional network for faster home renovation
records.the_problem: Home finishing and renovation can be fragmented, slow, and difficult to price reliably.
records.what_they_built: Ostafandy combines online home design, instant smart quotes, payments, and a network of service providers in one workflow.
records.the_asip_connection: During the programme, Ostafandy signed partnerships with Fanni, Adeer, and 15 local partners, and opened discussions with Senegal's National Association of Carpenters.
records.where_they_are_now: The Cohort 4 report records $175K generated, 560 service providers, and 4,400 quotes issued.
